games.name: [VAMPIRE] Vesteria
games.desc:
You are an adventurer traveling by carriage when your journey is cut short by a monster attack. You awaken in a strange mushroom town, far from where you intended to go. As you help the people of Mushtown, you grow stronger, uncover the world’s secrets, and begin to understand the forces shaping Vesteria.

Vesteria is an open-world MMORPG on Roblox, shaped by a highly engaged community and a living player-driven economy. Explore sprawling cities, distant regions, and handcrafted worlds, take on dangerous dungeons and bosses, and trade rare items through a thriving global marketplace.

✨ Upon reaching Level 10 in Mushtown, follow the path to Nilgarf to meet the Baron and begin your journey as a Warrior, Hunter, or Mage.

🌎 Multiple cities, regions, and worlds to explore
⚔️ Challenging bosses and dungeons
🏛️ Global marketplace driven by players
👥 Passionate, long-running community

games.name: [ALPHA] Route 06
games.desc:
⚠️ The game is on a alpha stage and plenty of features are still underdeveloped and unpolished, everything is subject to change. ⚠️

Welcome to Route 06! A CO-OP game where you and 4 more friends drive across a randomly generated map with randomly generated structures, fighting to survive and using what you can to defend yourself along the way.

Use a variety of different survivors each having their own abilities and fight hordes of zombies, with some of them having their own unique tweaks to spice up each run! 

The game tries to give the player as much freedom as possible, giving you a chance to play the game at your own pace and however you want.
